SIGNALS.name: Guillaume Lample
SIGNALS.summary: Mistral cofounder announces a preview of Mistral Large 4: a 1T-parameter model with 49B active parameters, trained natively with multimodal capabilities.

SIGNALS.name: Reflection
SIGNALS.summary: Reflection introduces Beam, an open model with 501B total and 23B active parameters, trained from scratch. Full weights are due to be released this month.

SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: Reports, citing Tibor Blaho, that OpenAI is rolling out invisible text watermarking for ChatGPT and Codex in the EU to meet AI Act text provenance rules.

SIGNALS.name: Kai
SIGNALS.summary: Says Google Antigravity added Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 for paid Pro and Ultra plans; the free student Pro plan does not include them.

SIGNALS.name: CNBC
SIGNALS.summary: CNBC reports Anthropic will invest $100 million to train AI engineering talent.

SIGNALS.name: Arena.ai
SIGNALS.summary: Arena.ai says Claude Sonnet 5.5 landed at #3 in its Agent Arena, with a median cost per task of $2.74, higher than the #2 Claude Opus 5.5 at $1.58.

SIGNALS.name: AI at Meta
SIGNALS.summary: Meta says mathematicians worked with its AI over several months on problems with no known solution path, after its models earned gold-medal-level results in five STEM competitions.

SIGNALS.name: NVIDIA RTX Spark
SIGNALS.summary: NVIDIA says DGX Spark is getting a 64GB option built on the GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip, for running local agents on device, with a new Sync Cluster Assistant for pairing systems.

SIGNALS.name: Google
SIGNALS.summary: Google introduces Gemini 4 Argon, aimed at software engineering, knowledge work and cybersecurity defense, with a 1M token output limit.
